name: Liquidation Preference
title: Liquidation Preference
text:
It is proposed that {{ts_liquidation_text}}.
(a) "Liquidity Event" means a winding up of the Company, a sale of all or substantially all of its assets, or a sale or transfer of shares that results in a change of control of the Company.
(b) Any liquidation preference operates only in the distribution of proceeds among shareholders. On a winding up, creditors rank ahead of all shareholders, including under Section 53 of the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 where that Code applies, and no arrangement among shareholders affects the rights of creditors.

legal_basis.note: Kinds of share capital; a preferential right on a winding up is a feature of preference share capital
Distribution of assets in liquidation; equity shareholders rank last

source: Companies Act, 2013; Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016
authoring_note: Participation is the largest economic term in the document and is chosen by the user, never assumed. A preference on equity shares is flagged for review because Section 43 attaches the preferential right to preference share capital.
d4_44: Rebuilt 9 Oct 2026. Non-binding provisions are drafted as proposals ('it is proposed that ... be'), never as obligations, so the wording agrees with the Status provision.
